data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 69.179m. During 2014 there was a reported improvement (release) on prior-year claims reserves described as an improvement of GBP 2.4m, principally driven by favourable development on property reserves. This release is stated in the accounts as a component of net claims incurred; no explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided, so the GBP 2.4m quoted is net of reinsurance. Named loss events cited in the report that have influenced reserve movements in prior years include Superstorm Sandy (2012), Mexican windstorms (Manuel and Ingrid), Central European flooding, and notable man-made losses such as the Julius Klein diamond heist (2013).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount used is the reported GBP 2.4m 'improvement' quoted in the technical provisions note; that figure is presented as part of net claims incurred and is therefore net of reinsurance. No explicit gross prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities column) was found in the notes. The 'movement in provision' reconciliation table shows total movements including current year activity and therefore was not used for prior-year-only development. If a gross prior-year movement is required, it is not separately disclosed in the available notes-net figure used as fallback.
